Here is a short text. Read it and then summarise it in two sentences.

The city library opened a new reading room last month. It has large windows, comfortable chairs and a quiet area for students. On weekends it hosts free workshops on topics like photography, cooking and basic programming. Since the opening, the number of visitors has almost doubled, and the library is now planning to extend its opening hours in the evening so that people who work during the day can also use it.
